headline: NYY @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.11 at DET 4.15, with a projected total of 8.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: NYY moved -0.08 runs while DET moved +0.30, changing the projected margin by -0.38 runs. NRFI probability rose +7.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Casey Mize has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Kevin McGonigle, Anthony Volpe, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
